name: darasistema
description: Sistema de Facturacion y Contabilidad - Darasistema (gas, oxigeno y agua purificada)
author: Darasistema

scripts.dev:electron: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron dist-electron/main.js
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist:full: node scripts/set-variant.js full && cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=full npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:caja: node scripts/set-variant.js caja && cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=caja npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.caja.yml
